description: This file defines a Java interface named Logger with default implementation for console logging. It includes methods for logging trace, info, and error messages with timestamping. The interface provides a singleton console logger implementation.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A Java interface for logging messages with default console implementation.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message with timestamp.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an informational message with timestamp.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message with timestamp to standard error.
